inputs.spec_clause_ref: kerml clause 8.2.4.3.1 (Features.md, region_sha256 c9b4ff39176a7e05) | sysml clause 8.2.2.6.2 (Usages.md, region_sha256 a6f6e20afeed05e4)

decision: A membership that wraps exactly one OwnedCrossFeature, with no tokens of its own. KerML 8.2.4.3.1 and SysML 8.2.2.6.2 state the same body, `ownedRelatedElement += OwnedCrossFeature`, so this is one shared unit. The two languages do define OwnedCrossFeature differently: in KerML it is BasicFeaturePrefix FeatureDeclaration, and in SysML it is a ReferenceUsage, BasicUsagePrefix UsageDeclaration. That difference belongs to OwnedCrossFeature, not here, and the reference resolves to each language's own variant. The SysML Xtext rule agrees.

evidence.note: line 11: `end [0..1] feature cart: ShoppingCart[1];`. The `[0..1]` after `end` is the cross feature, a FeatureDeclaration made only of a MultiplicityPart, which EndFeaturePrefix's optional OwnedCrossFeatureMember admits.
OwnedCrossFeatureMember returns SysML::OwningMembership: ownedRelatedElement += OwnedCrossFeature. Agrees.
